authored_scope: 40 additional individually scripted source-linked worksite encounters, LV_041-LV_080; total 80 of 200, 120 remain base-family only

entries.title: Dust-sealed transformer interlock
entries.stakes: Keep metallic dust outside Hammer Street's transformer while proving the drain chamber is electrically separated before its storefront feeders return.

entries.title: Terminus reset without a surge
entries.stakes: Stage a reversible restart at the Casting Tram Terminus without sending the trapped traction current into the boarding platform.

entries.title: Foundry clinic dual feed
entries.stakes: Resolve contradictory incoming routes to the workers' clinic while preventing conductive foundry dust from entering the medical isolation cabinet.

entries.title: Bellmakers restart ladder
entries.stakes: Bring the narrow Bellmaker's Alley substation out of a dust fault without waking the downstream bell furnace circuit prematurely.

entries.source_title: Cooling Water Station: Network loop hunt
entries.title: Cooling station loop fracture
entries.stakes: Identify a recirculating control loop at the Cooling Water Station before dust-contaminated controls let the foundry cooling pumps reverse.

entries.title: Clocktower's short window
entries.stakes: Use the repeater's brief clean-air service opening to restore time signals before metallic dust shorts the external antenna bypass.

entries.title: School cold storage rescue
entries.stakes: Keep the Patternmakers' School supply cabinet free of conducting dust while stabilizing the class refrigeration stores before their timer expires.

entries.title: Fire hall isolated bypass
entries.stakes: Prepare the Guild Fire Hall reserve branch without coupling its pump starter to the dusty general service bus.

entries.title: Willow sluice access lock
entries.stakes: Silt has trapped the Willow Bend Feeder's access switch; prove the channel gate is secure before exposing its feeder terminations.

entries.title: Bridge thermal breaker
entries.stakes: Protect walkers above the river as silt-jammed cable drains overheat the Riverwalk Footbridge's breaker cabinet.

entries.title: Dispensary cross-feed dispute
entries.stakes: Separate the Lowbank Dispensary's emergency source from the submerged municipal branch to keep medicine power from backfeeding the levee.

entries.title: Orchard cooperative label audit
entries.stakes: Correct a false loading-dock feeder label while silt-contaminated supply runs still serve the cooperative's sorting machinery.

entries.source_title: East Levee Pump Shed: Sticking isolator
entries.title: Pump shed trapped isolator
entries.stakes: Free the East Levee Pump Shed's seized isolator without stopping the river-stage telemetry needed for flood defense.

entries.title: Pavilion source purity
entries.stakes: Protect Flood Warning Pavilion transmitters from river-silt leakage by verifying a clean source before the warning beacon is brought online.

entries.title: Meadow archive survival
entries.stakes: Move the Meadow Science Classroom's wet research archive onto a verified backup without energizing its silt-coated cabinets.

entries.title: Barn opening deadline
entries.stakes: Prepare the Raised Community Barn's emergency shelter circuit ahead of its public opening while silt still blocks the access duct.

entries.title: Lockkeeper reel allocation
entries.stakes: Use one remaining cable reel at Lockkeeper Distribution to bypass the jammed gate feeder without leaving the lock controls unpowered.

entries.source_title: Towpath Lift Gate: Staged pump sequence
entries.title: Towpath staged lift
entries.stakes: Recover the Towpath Lift Gate in pump-first order so the jammed chamber cannot move before its flood relief circuit stabilizes.

entries.title: Barge medical grounding
entries.stakes: Stop an intermittent shore-to-barge earth fault before reconnecting the medic cabin's life-support auxiliary circuit.

entries.title: Wharf beacon continuity
entries.stakes: Prove the Old Wharf Provisioner's emergency beacon circuit across the lock gate fault rather than trusting a glowing but isolated lamp.

entries.source_title: Twin Chamber Pump Room: Load-budget dilemma
entries.title: Twin pump capacity verdict
entries.stakes: Balance the Twin Chamber Pump Room's two loads with a jammed lock inlet, choosing relief capacity over premature secondary pumping.

entries.source_title: Signal Flag Turret: False fuse alarm
entries.title: Turret false fuse isolation
entries.stakes: Distinguish a false fuse alarm from a gate-induced telemetry error at Signal Flag Turret before disabling the channel distress signal.

entries.title: Navigator deck drainage
entries.stakes: Verify drainage below the Navigator Training Deck before energizing students' consoles next to the stalled lock gate.

entries.title: North Lock safe reset
entries.stakes: Keep the North Lock Shelter supplied through a reversible reset while the seized lock mechanism is isolated from the refuge circuit.

entries.title: Switchyard sprayproof splice
entries.stakes: Dry and join the Upper Falls Switchyard's severed cable without letting waterfall spray bridge the exposed splice terminals.

entries.title: Cableway load shedding
entries.stakes: Keep the Spraybridge Cableway carriage stationary until its relay cabinet dries and the unwanted traction branch is fully shed.

entries.title: Rescue clinic generator trade
entries.stakes: Prioritize the Falls Rescue Clinic's oxygen and cold-storage supply over noncritical generator load during relay spray ingress.

entries.title: Food court pressure relief
entries.stakes: Avoid a second pressure trip at Millstone Food Court by isolating the sprayed booster relay before restoring kitchens.

entries.title: Pressure house dispatch
entries.stakes: Route the Cascade Pressure House's scarce dry power to essential pressure regulation while the oversprayed relays are serviced.

entries.title: Cliffside conflicting signals
entries.stakes: Cross-check two contradictory Cliffside Repeater telemetry channels before declaring the river warning net restored.

entries.title: Workshop safety interlock
entries.stakes: Secure the Hydro Workshop School's access interlock before pupils' test benches can draw current from a spray-soaked service board.

entries.title: Volunteer hall hot breaker
entries.stakes: Restore Riverside Volunteer Hall's relief refrigeration only after verifying its thermal breaker has cooled beyond the falls spray mist.

entries.title: Terminal intake restart
entries.stakes: Restart Terminal Intake Bay supply after confirming platform storm runoff has cleared the sequence-controller entry sensors.

entries.source_title: Rainline Departure Hall: Network loop hunt
entries.title: Departure hall loop hunt
entries.stakes: Find the Rainline Departure Hall's unintended platform feedback loop before its display banks can be reenergized safely.

entries.source_title: Platform Seven Clinic: Brief service window
entries.title: Platform clinic service slot
entries.stakes: Use Platform Seven Clinic's narrow service interval to reconnect critical care lamps without waking the storm-faulted rail bus.

entries.title: Luggage cold chain
entries.stakes: Protect perishable medicine stored at Lost Luggage Bazaar by shifting its cold room off the platform storm feeder.

entries.title: Trackbed drain bypass
entries.stakes: Isolate Trackbed Drain Plant's failed storm sequencer and stage a dry bypass before sending the tunnel pumps back online.

entries.title: Dispatch cabin sag diagnosis
entries.stakes: Separate a true voltage sag from false storm-sequencer flags at Dispatch Signal Cabin to prevent spurious train departure clearance.

entries.source_title: Driver Training Suite: Limited cable reel
entries.title: Driver suite cable shortage
entries.stakes: Allocate the Driver Training Suite's remaining cable run between simulator consoles without touching the live platform signal bus.

entries.source_title: Night Passenger Shelter: Staged pump sequence
entries.title: Night shelter pump order
entries.stakes: Keep Night Passenger Shelter lighting stable by staging the trackbed pump sequence before transferring refuge heaters.
